Folks, I've see a lot of anger on twitter in regards to how Gamergate never gets its chance to share its side of the story pops up in the media. Any media from mainstream, to blogs, podcasts, doesn't matter they either stick to the narrative or just stick to presenting their own opinion on the situation without even giving us a chance.

You'd think after 10 months of this people would stop getting their hopes up? Well I hate to be a pessimist, but lets be real everyone, we wont get our chance to share our side of the story when the story peaks its head into the conversation. Why wont we get our chance to share our side of the story you wonder?

Aside from the “harassing women is bad” narrative that most of the media sticks to, take a look at why we're never given the benefit of the doubt and given a chance to speak. We're gamers. We're the sub culture that its ok to hate, that its acceptable to dehumanize and treat like shit.

Just like comic fans of the 70's and 80's, we're the ones its funny to target because the lesson from High school that its ok to treat others like shit because you don't like them, carries over into adulthood. Don't ignore them, don't leave them alone and focus on your own life, call them rapists and pedophiles. Thats how people know you're cool and not a psychopath.

We aren't going to get to chance to talk with this people folks, we're a talking point not a community. Thats how biased things are right now, if it was any other industry, like the stock market refusing to purchase a trading magazine and because they got caught colluding with a scumbag company, and now both the company and the magazine are under heavy scrutiny and cynicism, it would be called a consumer revolt.

We're not even granted that, we're still called a harassment campaign run by white people. Thats how retarded the situation with the media is, because they still don't see the hobby being anything but basement dwelling lonely white guys, despite how many people who aren't white or male play video games.

But its worse than that because the assumption that everyone who is angry is still a teenager or an unemployed guy in his 20s is still strong. Because no one who is pro gamergate is an engineer, or an artist, A soldier, a veteran, a lawyer, or a father, a mother, even a porn star.

Its all just the same angry white men who want to oppress the world, ya know the ones who hide in their parents basements and not the assholes who run giant banks or large corporations that destroy the environment and the lives of people who make their cheap products in China.

We're the ones who are completely at fault for demanding ethical journalism, so naturally we shouldn't have the right to speak or present an argument by anyone who is a journalist or produces their own media where they talk about the news. We can get mad, or we can stop caring, laugh at the bullshit and go about our lives doing what we can to finish a fight that we didn't start. It doesn't matter that any of media don't want to listen to us or actually do fact checking.

They're either promoting the narrative or promoting themselves, they have no effect on us because the longer this goes on the larger we grow and sooner or later they will give up, because in the case of the people who go out of their way to antagonize us, always seem to have the most skeletons in their closet. Gamergate is almost 1 year old now, if you haven't thicken your skin yet, do it. We're in this for the long haul. The media isn't there to tell the truth, they're there to make money. Honesty isn't as important as tragedy. Its time to accept this and move on.
